answer_text: Approximately 850,000 riders delivered at least one order for Delivery Hero in 2024.

Zalando changed Zalando Plus in 2024 from a paid membership to a free-to-join model with a points-based system rewarding loyalty, initially tested in Spain and expanded to France and Austria, with further rollout planned for 2025 [1][4][5]. The awards create a separate performance obligation providing a material right to customers [3]. At year-end, the report mentions increased accruals for the reimbursement of Zalando Plus subscription fees to customers at the beginning of 2025, included in "others" within other current non-financial liabilities [2].

Vodafone Turkey - 2G licence extension: €120 million for a six-year extension until 30 April 2029 (excluding 18% VAT), paid in advance with a capital injection.
Turkcell - 2G licence extension: EUR 120 million (plus EUR 21.6 million of value-added taxes), paid in instalments — an initial payment of EUR 81.6 million (down payment plus VAT) paid in TRY 1.7 billion during 2023, approximately EUR 31.1 million of remaining instalments paid in TRY 1.1 billion in April 2024, with the remainder due within a year.

Both operators agreed to the same extension fee of €120 million (excluding VAT) for the extension to 30 April 2029, but Vodafone Turkey paid the fee in advance via a capital injection, whereas Turkcell paid in instalments in Turkish Lira, with part of the amount still outstanding.
